Thomas Paine, The Rights of Man, edited by Moncure Daniel Conway.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/thomas-paine/the-rights-of-man

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Thomas Paine (annotator, author, role code dto), died 1809.
- Moncure Daniel Conway (annotator, editor, writer of introduction), died 1907.

First publication of the text used (SE colophon: 'The Rights of Man was published in 1791 and 1792 by Thomas Paine. Threadable sponsored the production of this ebook for Standard Ebooks. It was produced by David Grigg, and is based on a transcription produced in 2003 by Norman M. Wolcott and David Widger for Project Gutenberg and on digital scans from the HathiTrust Digital Library. The cover page is adapted from Portrait du Chanteur Simon Chenard en Costume de Sans-Culotte, a painting completed in 1792 by Louis-Léopold Boilly. The cover and title pages feature the League Spartan and Sorts Mill Goudy typefaces created in 2014 and 2009 by The League of Moveable Type.
